content.text:
Start at https://www.google.com and complete the following task.

I’m trying to put together a cozy monthly subscription night for a friend in the UK and want one tidy recommendation I can actually look at in the browser afterward. Please start on Beer52 and figure out which of their beer subscription plans are genuine monthly options that deliver within the UK, because I only want plans that would work for a regular monthly treat here rather than anything one-off or unclear. Open the relevant Beer52 plan pages in separate tabs and leave the best evidence visible so I can compare them myself. Once you know the monthly beer choices, go to snackd.co.uk and find at least three snack subscription boxes that also deliver to the UK, then open each actual product or brand page so you can verify from the site itself that UK delivery or shipping is available and leave those tabs open too, since I want to see the boxes and not just a summary. After that, use Google to work out which UK streaming subscription service includes the movie “Wicked” at no extra cost in the base subscription, and please make sure it’s not just a rental, purchase option, add-on channel, or ad-supported loophole because I want something I could actually pair with the subscription night without paying extra for the film. Open the page that proves where it’s included and keep that tab available. Finally, check PrintPigeon and explain, in plain English, how it takes an email or online message and turns it into a posted letter, and tell me the current price for sending one standard UK letter so I can decide whether mailing the invite is worth the extra effort. In the end, give me one coherent summary that pulls together the Beer52 monthly UK options, the three snack alternatives with UK-delivery proof, the streaming service for “Wicked,” and the PrintPigeon explanation and letter price.

Rules:
- You may use search engines and open new tabs. When the task asks you to leave a page open, keep it open in its own tab and say in your final answer which page is in which tab.
- Do NOT use cached/archived copies of pages (e.g. web.archive.org); work from the live sites.
- If a site you need is blocked (bot check, login wall, error), first try to get through it — complete a bot check yourself, retry, or use another route to the same page. If it still cannot be reached, say so explicitly in your answer and do not fill in from memory what you could not read on the page.
- When the task is complete, give your final answer as plain text in your last message.

						The monthly plan is billed every 28 days. You can check when you're next due to be billed at any time by logging into your online account. Just click on the “Settings” icon on the right hand side of your screen and select the “Subscription” heading to view the date.
						
							

							Where your next billing date will appear is marked by the red star in the image below!
							
						
					


					What Beers Will I Get?
						Our team carefully curates a selection of craft beers which varies depending on the monthly theme. All you have to do is choose whether you'd like a mix of light and dark beers or light beers only and we'll do the rest!
						
							
						
					


					What's In The Case?
						Depending on your plan, you'll receive 8 or 10 or 12 or 16 craft beers which may be in bottles or cans, as well as the latest edition of Ferment Magazine (the UK's number one craft beer magazine featuring content about the wider world, history and science of beer) and two delicious artisan snacks to enjoy.  All items sold separately, contact us to amend your subscription.
					

					


					
						What Is The Difference Between A Mixed Or Light Case?
							
								With the Mixed cases we include 2 or 3 stouts, porters, or other types of dark beer alongside your regular beers. With the Light cases, these dark beers are replaced with more of the pale ales, IPAs, and so forth.
							
						

						I Want Dark Beers, Can You Help?
							Unfortunately we don't offer a dark beer only box but if you’re a fan of the darker side of beer, then the Mixed case is for you! With the Mixed cases we include 2 or 3 stouts, porters, or other types of dark beer as part of your selection. Please note, our mixed case is not suitable for Vegans at this time.
						
					


					Do I Get An Order Confirmation?
						
							When you place your first order, we'll send you a Welcome email which gives you a breakdown of your order and your ongoing plan. For future orders, we don't send out reminder emails but you can always see your next billing date in the “Subscription” section of your account. You'll also receive an email containing tracking information once your order is dispatched from our warehouse.
							You can check when your next billing date is at any time by logging into your online account. Just click on the “Settings” icon on the right hand side of your screen and select the “Subscription” heading to view the date.
							

							Where your next billing date will appear is marked by the red star in the image below!
							
						
					


					Do I Get Tracking Updates?
						
							Tracking information will be emailed to you as soon as your order is dispatched. You can also find this information in the “Order history” section of your online account, where the details of your current and previous orders are all available.
							You can access this information by selecting “My Beer52” from the banner running along the top of your screen, and then choosing “Track My Orders” from the drop-down menu
							

							From here, you'll be able to see whereabouts in the packing and dispatch process your order is.
							

							Once dispatched you'll have the option to “Track your parcel”
							

							If selected this screen will display your order number, tracking number and dispatch date, and will also provide you with a quick and easy way to register any delivery related issues with our customer support team.
							
						
					


					Can I Change How Often I Get Deliveries?
						
							Absolutely! If you are looking to move to a more spaced out plan just drop us an email or give us a call and we can switch you to a 1 box every 2 months or even 1 box every 3 months plan no problem at all.
						
					
				

				
					What's Beer52?

					What We Do
						
							We're the UK's largest craft beer discovery club and we send you a tasty selection of craft beers every month with our award-winning magazine about the world of beer, Ferment, and two artisan snacks to continue your craft adventure. Join us on a journey of discovery and share our favourite beers, snacks and stories from around the planet!
							Whether you have just discovered the fast-growing world of craft beer or you're a craft beer aficionado, our Ferment editions are designed to fuel your passion for flavour and to learn a little bit about the history, passion and people behind the world's greatest beverage.
							We work really closely with the breweries we feature to give you a little peek into their magical beery world and sometimes they create exclusive beers available only for our subscribers!
							Each tasty box of beer comes complete with two artisan snacks, as well as a copy of 100 page full-colour Ferment magazine where you can learn all about what's happening in the wider craft beer community ...it's essential reading!
							Want to find out more? Check out our website beer52.com
							
							
							
						
					


					
						Why We Are The Best Beer Club
							
							Don't take our word for it, here's what some of our 200,000 Beer Club members think of our service.
							
							
							
							
							
							
						
					


					How It Works
						When Does The Beer Arrive?
						When you sign up to our beer club, payment is taken immediately and your first order is processed for shipping. You will receive your first case via next day delivery if you order by 3pm, Monday - Friday. We also have a Saturday delivery option if you aren't available during the week.
						How frequent are deliveries?
						
							From sign up, you are billed every 28 days for a new box. You can change this if you would like deliveries to be less frequent, simply contact us through our Help Centre.
							
								We can change the frequency and the number of beers you are sent out as required.
							
						
					


					Can I Pick The Beers?
						For our subscription boxes, these are pre selected and cannot be changed. Our beer experts sample hundreds of beers every month in a mission to get the most exciting and diverse range of beers in your case. It's a tough job but somebody's gotta do it! That being said you can create your own box of beer within our online shop for one-off orders! Simply go to beer52.com/shop to get started.
					


					Do I Have To Sign Up?
						If you would like to enjoy the benefits of our Beer Club (loyalty rewards, free beers, merchandise and much more!) you must sign up to redeem our services. We're a subscription service, after all!
						
							You can however order a one-off box from beer52.com/gift and select 'One-Off Case'. Please note, discounts are not applicable on any of our gift products. They are only to be used with our Beer Club subscriptions.
						
					


					Where In The World Are You?
						We are based in Scotland's capital city, Edinburgh!
						Should you need to get in contact with us by snail mail, our address is below:
						
							Beer52
							8 Melville Crescent
							Edinburgh
							EH3 7JA
							Scotland
						
					
				

				
					Delivery

					What Courier Do You Use?
						Evri and InPost take care of our delivery services for mainland UK. Evri will be used as a courier if you live in other areas, such as Northern Ireland, the Scottish Highlands or Isle of Man.
					


					Do You Offer Next Day Delivery?
						Yes! Have a look at the countdown on the main page of our website. Order before this reaches zero to get next day delivery.
					


					How Fast is Delivery?
						For your first box, you can select Next Day delivery if you order by 8pm.Recurring subscription boxes have an average delivery time of 2-3 working days from the item being shipped out from our warehouse. It can take a little longer in some cases so please allow up to 3 working days from it being despatched before getting in touch.
					


					Track Your Box?
						On sign up, your box will be assigned a tracking number which can be found in your confirmation email or within your Beer52 account.Download the courier app for real time tracking on your box.  You can update your delivery preferences by choosing a safe place, leaving your box with a neighbour or diverting your box to a new address if you're not going to be home.
						
					


					How Do I Return My Box?
						
							If you would like to return a box, please contact us through our Help Centre and someone from our friendly team will assist you.  All returned items in your box must be unopened and the return logged with our customer service team.  Unfortunately, we cannot offer free returns on the boxes of beer due to their heavy weight.
						
						Due to the nature of our product, all cases are non-refundable unless defective in which we will send a replacement or a refund.
					


					
					
					
					
				

				
					Manage Your Beer52 Account

					Skip, Pause or Cancel Subscription
						You can make changes to your subscription at any time by logging into your Beer52 account.
						To pause your account or update your subscription, log into your account at www.beer52.com
						
							
						

						You'll be able to manage your subscription from here. To pause your account for a month, click the “Settings” icon visible on the right hand side of your screen. This will reveal a drop-down menu from which you can select a 'Subscription' heading.
						
							
						

						Once on the subscription page, just scroll down and click on 'Pause subscription for 1 month'.
						
							
						

						To take longer holidays, simply get in touch and let us know how long you would like to pause for and we'll get this arranged for you no problem!
						To cancel your subscription, you can easily reach our team before the date of your next payment by calling 0131 285 2684. We're open Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm.
						
							
						

						Please note that we require 24 hours to process your first order before you'll be able to cancel your subscription.
					


					Update Card Details
						If you need to update your billing information, please do so by logging into your account. From there, if you click on the “Settings” icon visible on the right hand side of your screen, you'll be able to select “My Wallet” to update your card details.
						
							
						

						Remember to click 'Update' to make sure the new details are saved!
						
							
						
					


					Update Address Details
						Whether you're moving house or want your box sent to a friend's place, you can easily update your delivery details by logging into your account and clicking the “Settings” icon visible on the right hand side of your screen. From there, just select “Delivery” to update your mobile number, delivery address, as well as any delivery instructions.
						
							
						

						It's useful to think about where might be a safe place for orders to be left if you're not home when delivery is made; if you know they'll be secure with a neighbour, on the front porch or in the shed out back, be sure to let your courier know this by completing the “Delivery Instructions” fields!
						
							
						
					


					
					
					
					


					Change My Password
						To change your password, simply log into your account, and click the “Settings” icon on the right hand side of your screen - from there you'll see a “Login Details” heading which, if clicked, will take you to this page where you can update your password.
						
							
						

						Just remember to click 'Update' for changes to apply! If you run into any difficulty here just contact us through our Help Centre and we'll get you sorted.
					


					
					
					
					
					
					


					Refer A Friend
						You can find the FAQ's for our refer a friend schemes HERE - https://www.beer52.com/invite-friend
					
				
				
					Christmas & New Year period

					Will my delivery be impacted during the holiday period?
						
							There will be some disruption to our usually prompt delivery timeframes around the Christmas and New Year period. Please note that no deliveries will be made on the following dates:
							
							
							24th December
							25th December
							26th December
							1st January
							

							Thank you for your understanding and patience during this time.

                            To ensure your delivery arrives before Christmas, please place your order by 9:00 PM on Friday, 19th December 2025.
							
                            Please note that this is a busier-than-normal period, and while we will do our best to meet this timeframe, unexpected delays may occur.
						
					

					When do I need to order by if I want my delivery to arrive before New Year’s Eve?
						
							To ensure your delivery arrives before New Year’s Eve, please place your order by 9:00 PM on Monday, 22nd December 2025. This is for orders opting for Express Delivery.
							
							Please be aware that this is a busier-than-normal period, and while we will strive to meet this timeframe, unexpected delays may occur.
						
					

					Will you be open during the holiday period?
						
							Our team will be here to support you as usual until up to and including Tuesday, 23rd December 2025. However, our offices will be closed on the following days:
							
							Christmas Eve
							Christmas Day
							Boxing Day
							New Year’s Day
							We will operate as normal on all other days.
							
							Thank you for your understanding and patience during this time.

							For both initial sign-up and subsequent subscription orders, your order will be assigned a courier and a tracking number which can be found in your confirmation email or within your Beer52 account’s order history.

Scenes of peril and threat

Themes of cruelty to animals some may find upsetting

Themes of bullying including parables of racism and prejudice

No violence or profanity

content.text:
Here is your complete guide for planning a monthly subscription night in the UK, with all evidence pages left open in their respective browser tabs.

---

### 1. Beer52: Genuine Monthly UK Subscription Plans

Beer52 operates as an ongoing discovery club billed every 28 days (monthly cadence) delivering across the UK (mainland via Evri/InPost, plus Northern Ireland, Scottish Highlands, and Isle of Man via Evri). Every monthly case includes a curated craft beer selection based on a rotating monthly theme, a 100-page full-colour copy of *Ferment* magazine, and 2 artisan beer snacks.

#### Plan Tiers:
* **8-Beer Club (Baseline Plan):**
  * **Price:** £27 for the first case, then £29.95 every 28 days (£27 base plan + £2.95 delivery charge applied from the 2nd order onwards).
  * **Contents:** 8 craft beers (bottles/cans), *Ferment* magazine, and 2 artisan snacks.
* **10-Beer Club (Upgrade Plan):**
  * **Price:** £33/month (+ £2.95 delivery from 2nd box; £6 add-on to the baseline plan).
  * **Contents:** 10 craft beers, *Ferment* magazine, and 2 artisan snacks.
* **12-Beer Club:**
  * **Price:** £39/month (+ £2.95 delivery from 2nd box).
  * **Contents:** 12 craft beers, *Ferment* magazine, and 2 artisan snacks.
* **16-Beer Club:**
  * **Price:** £51/month (+ £2.95 delivery from 2nd box).
  * **Contents:** 16 craft beers, *Ferment* magazine, and 2 artisan snacks.

#### Case Style Preferences:
* **Mixed Case:** A curated blend of light beers alongside 2–3 stouts, porters, or darker beers.
* **Light Case:** Dark beers are swapped out exclusively for pale ales, IPAs, and lagers.

---

### 2. Snack'd (snackd.co.uk): 3 Snack Subscription Boxes with UK Delivery Proof

Snack'd is a UK-based monthly subscription box delivering international snacks and treats. As explicitly confirmed on their subscription and shipping policy pages, **all subscription boxes include free UK shipping** (shipped during the first week of each month via Royal Mail 2nd Class / Evri):

1. **Mini Box**
   * **Price:** £8.99/month (or £8.49/month on a quarterly prepay plan).
   * **Contents:** 5 unique, authentic snacks from various countries around the world, complete with snack info cards (no drink included).
   * **UK Delivery:** Free UK shipping included.
2. **Classic Box (Most Popular)**
   * **Price:** £14.99/month (or £14.49/month on a quarterly prepay plan).
   * **Contents:** 10 international snacks from various countries + 1 international drink, plus snack tasting notes.
   * **UK Delivery:** Free UK shipping included.
3. **Sharing Box**
   * **Price:** £24.99/month (or £24.49/month on a quarterly prepay plan).
   * **Contents:** 20 snacks (double portions of the 10 Classic treats) + 2 international drinks; designed for 2+ people or families.
   * **UK Delivery:** Free UK shipping included.

---

### 3. Streaming "Wicked" at No Extra Cost

* **Streaming Service:** **Sky Cinema** and **NOW** (via the **NOW Cinema Membership**).
* **Subscription Status:** Included on-demand at **no extra cost** within the base Sky Cinema / NOW Cinema subscription package. It is **not** a rental or one-off digital store purchase (such as on Prime Video or Apple TV) and not behind a paywall add-on channel.
* **Evidence:** Sky’s official watch portal explicitly confirms:  
  * *"The first Wicked movie is available to watch now exclusively on Sky Cinema – all you need is a subscription and you will have instant access!"*  
  * *"Wicked is available to watch now on Sky Cinema and NOW."*

---

### 4. PrintPigeon: How It Works & UK Letter Pricing

#### How it turns an online message into a physical posted letter (in plain English):
1. **Compose or Upload:** You visit PrintPigeon online and either paste/type your message into their web editor (or pick an invite template) or upload a pre-made PDF or Word document containing your letter.
2. **Addressing & Proofing:** You enter the recipient’s UK postal address and your return details. PrintPigeon displays an instant digital PDF proof on screen so you can verify layout and margins.
3. **Printing & Packaging:** Once submitted, PrintPigeon prints the document on 100gsm paper using high-grade laser printing (in black & white or full colour). Automated machinery folds the letter, places it into an envelope, and seals it.
4. **Franking & Posting:** PrintPigeon franks the envelope and hands it over directly to **Royal Mail** for physical delivery. Orders submitted before 2:30 PM (Monday–Friday) are dispatched the same day.

#### Current Price for Sending One Standard UK Letter (1 Page):
* **Base Printing & Envelope Fee:** **£2.99** (includes first page printing, premium envelope, and secure handling).
* **Total Cost by Delivery Speed:**
  * **Free Standard Shipping (5–7 working days):** **£2.99 total**
  * **Royal Mail 2nd Class (2–5 working days, +£0.99):** **£3.98 total**
  * **Royal Mail 1st Class Express (1–2 working days, +£2.99):** **£5.98 total**
  * **Royal Mail 2nd Class Tracked (+£3.99):** **£6.98 total**
  * **Royal Mail 1st Class Tracked (+£4.99):** **£7.98 total**
  * *(Extra pages, if your letter exceeds one page, cost £0.30/page for B&W or £0.40/page for colour).*

---

### Browser Tabs Open for Your Review

* **Tab 103795220:** `https://www.beer52.com/subscription#step2` — Beer52 interactive subscription flow showing the Mixed vs Light selection and 8-pack vs 10-pack upgrade.
* **Tab 103795287:** `https://www.beer52.com/faq` — Beer52 official FAQ page showing all plan costs (£27 for 8, £33 for 10, £39 for 12, £51 for 16), 28-day billing cycle, and courier delivery breakdown.
* **Tab 103795288:** `https://snackd.co.uk/subscribe` — Snack’d main subscription plans page showing the Mini, Classic, and Sharing boxes with explicit *"Shipping is free for addresses in the United Kingdom"*.
* **Tab 103795289:** `https://www.subbly.co/checkout/...` — Snack’d Mini Box dedicated product/checkout page.
* **Tab 103795292:** `https://www.subbly.co/checkout/...` — Snack’d Classic Box dedicated product/checkout page.
* **Tab 103795293:** `https://www.subbly.co/checkout/...` — Snack’d Sharing Box dedicated product/checkout page.
* **Tab 103795294:** `https://www.sky.com/watch/wicked` — Sky’s official Wicked page proving inclusion on Sky Cinema and NOW at no extra charge.
* **Tab 103795295:** `https://printpigeon.co.uk/pricing` — PrintPigeon official pricing page detailing the £2.99 base price and Royal Mail postal options.

					New Members

					How Much Does It Cost?
							£27 for 8 beers or £33 for 10 beers or £39 for 12 beers or £51 for 16 beers on a monthly plan billed every 28 days.
							Our 8 pack monthly subscription club includes 8 beers (£14.01) a copy of our magazine, Ferment (£7.99) 2 beer snacks (£5). The price of £27 includes VAT of £2.34.Our 10 pack monthly subscription club includes 10 beers (£20.01) a copy of our magazine, Ferment (£7.99) 2 beer snacks (£5). The price of £33 includes VAT of £3.34.Our 12 pack monthly subscription club includes 12 beers (£26.01) a copy of our magazine, Ferment (£7.99) 2 beer snacks (£5). The price of £39 includes VAT of £4.34. Our 16 pack monthly subscription club includes 16 beers (£38.01) a copy of our magazine, Ferment (£7.99) 2 beer snacks (£5). The price of £51 includes VAT of £6.34.
                        
                            
								
									Starting with your second order, a £2.95 delivery charge applies to each order. This charge includes VAT, applied in proportion to the VAT rates of the items in your pack.
								
							
                        
					


					How frequent are deliveries?
						Deliveries are every 28 days. Don't worry, if you run out then you can just contact us through our Help Centre and we'll send you some more.
						
							If you find that you aren't keeping up, we also have plans where you can get a box every 2 or every 3 months instead.
						
						
					


					
						How Do I Sign Up?
							Whether you have a gift card, voucher or just want to get started with us you can head over to www.beer52.com
							If you don't have any gift cards or vouchers, head over to www.beer52.com and click on the big 'Get Started' button to kick off your craft beer journey.
							If you have a gift card or a voucher, click on 'Promo or gift code?' (Underneath Get Started button) on our home page www.beer52.com.
							

							A pop out will appear, enter your code into the box and click on 'Claim My Voucher'.
							

							On the next page, you will be shown the discount applied.
							

							Your next billing date and price will be confirmed to you at every stage of inputting your personal details.
							
							

							Once you've filled out all your details and checked these over, just click 'Place my order' to start your craft beer subscription.
							

							Your account dashboard will be displayed once you've successfully signed up with us.
							
						
					

					


					When Do I Get Billed?
						The monthly plan is billed every 28 days. You can check when you're next due to be billed at any time by logging into your online account. Just click on the “Settings” icon on the right hand side of your screen and select the “Subscription” heading to view the date.
						
							

							Where your next billing date will appear is marked by the red star in the image below!
							
						
					


					What Beers Will I Get?
						Our team carefully curates a selection of craft beers which varies depending on the monthly theme. All you have to do is choose whether you'd like a mix of light and dark beers or light beers only and we'll do the rest!
						
							
						
					


					What's In The Case?
						Depending on your plan, you'll receive 8 or 10 or 12 or 16 craft beers which may be in bottles or cans, as well as the latest edition of Ferment Magazine (the UK's number one craft beer magazine featuring content about the wider world, history and science of beer) and two delicious artisan snacks to enjoy.  All items sold separately, contact us to amend your subscription.
					

					


					
						What Is The Difference Between A Mixed Or Light Case?
							
								With the Mixed cases we include 2 or 3 stouts, porters, or other types of dark beer alongside your regular beers. With the Light cases, these dark beers are replaced with more of the pale ales, IPAs, and so forth.
							
						

						I Want Dark Beers, Can You Help?
							Unfortunately we don't offer a dark beer only box but if you’re a fan of the darker side of beer, then the Mixed case is for you! With the Mixed cases we include 2 or 3 stouts, porters, or other types of dark beer as part of your selection. Please note, our mixed case is not suitable for Vegans at this time.
						
					


					Do I Get An Order Confirmation?
						
							When you place your first order, we'll send you a Welcome email which gives you a breakdown of your order and your ongoing plan. For future orders, we don't send out reminder emails but you can always see your next billing date in the “Subscription” section of your account. You'll also receive an email containing tracking information once your order is dispatched from our warehouse.
							You can check when your next billing date is at any time by logging into your online account. Just click on the “Settings” icon on the right hand side of your screen and select the “Subscription” heading to view the date.
							

							Where your next billing date will appear is marked by the red star in the image below!
							
						
					


					Do I Get Tracking Updates?
						
							Tracking information will be emailed to you as soon as your order is dispatched. You can also find this information in the “Order history” section of your online account, where the details of your current and previous orders are all available.
							You can access this information by selecting “My Beer52” from the banner running along the top of your screen, and then choosing “Track My Orders” from the drop-down menu
							

							From here, you'll be able to see whereabouts in the packing and dispatch process your order is.
							

							Once dispatched you'll have the option to “Track your parcel”
							

							If selected this screen will display your order number, tracking number and dispatch date, and will also provide you with a quick and easy way to register any delivery related issues with our customer support team.
							
						
					


					Can I Change How Often I Get Deliveries?
						
							Absolutely! If you are looking to move to a more spaced out plan just drop us an email or give us a call and we can switch you to a 1 box every 2 months or even 1 box every 3 months plan no problem at all.
						
					
				

				
					What's Beer52?

					What We Do
						
							We're the UK's largest craft beer discovery club and we send you a tasty selection of craft beers every month with our award-winning magazine about the world of beer, Ferment, and two artisan snacks to continue your craft adventure. Join us on a journey of discovery and share our favourite beers, snacks and stories from around the planet!
							Whether you have just discovered the fast-growing world of craft beer or you're a craft beer aficionado, our Ferment editions are designed to fuel your passion for flavour and to learn a little bit about the history, passion and people behind the world's greatest beverage.
							We work really closely with the breweries we feature to give you a little peek into their magical beery world and sometimes they create exclusive beers available only for our subscribers!
							Each tasty box of beer comes complete with two artisan snacks, as well as a copy of 100 page full-colour Ferment magazine where you can learn all about what's happening in the wider craft beer community ...it's essential reading!
							Want to find out more? Check out our website beer52.com
							
							
							
						
					


					
						Why We Are The Best Beer Club
							
							Don't take our word for it, here's what some of our 200,000 Beer Club members think of our service.
							
							
							
							
							
							
						
					


					How It Works
						When Does The Beer Arrive?
						When you sign up to our beer club, payment is taken immediately and your first order is processed for shipping. You will receive your first case via next day delivery if you order by 3pm, Monday - Friday. We also have a Saturday delivery option if you aren't available during the week.
						How frequent are deliveries?
						
							From sign up, you are billed every 28 days for a new box. You can change this if you would like deliveries to be less frequent, simply contact us through our Help Centre.
							
								We can change the frequency and the number of beers you are sent out as required.
							
						
					


					Can I Pick The Beers?
						For our subscription boxes, these are pre selected and cannot be changed. Our beer experts sample hundreds of beers every month in a mission to get the most exciting and diverse range of beers in your case. It's a tough job but somebody's gotta do it! That being said you can create your own box of beer within our online shop for one-off orders! Simply go to beer52.com/shop to get started.
					


					Do I Have To Sign Up?
						If you would like to enjoy the benefits of our Beer Club (loyalty rewards, free beers, merchandise and much more!) you must sign up to redeem our services. We're a subscription service, after all!
						
							You can however order a one-off box from beer52.com/gift and select 'One-Off Case'. Please note, discounts are not applicable on any of our gift products. They are only to be used with our Beer Club subscriptions.
						
					


					Where In The World Are You?
						We are based in Scotland's capital city, Edinburgh!
						Should you need to get in contact with us by snail mail, our address is below:
						
							Beer52
							8 Melville Crescent
							Edinburgh
							EH3 7JA
							Scotland
						
					
				

				
					Delivery

					What Courier Do You Use?
						Evri and InPost take care of our delivery services for mainland UK. Evri will be used as a courier if you live in other areas, such as Northern Ireland, the Scottish Highlands or Isle of Man.
					


					Do You Offer Next Day Delivery?
						Yes! Have a look at the countdown on the main page of our website. Order before this reaches zero to get next day delivery.
					


					How Fast is Delivery?
						For your first box, you can select Next Day delivery if you order by 8pm.Recurring subscription boxes have an average delivery time of 2-3 working days from the item being shipped out from our warehouse. It can take a little longer in some cases so please allow up to 3 working days from it being despatched before getting in touch.
					


					Track Your Box?
						On sign up, your box will be assigned a tracking number which can be found in your confirmation email or within your Beer52 account.Download the courier app for real time tracking on your box.  You can update your delivery preferences by choosing a safe place, leaving your box with a neighbour or diverting your box to a new address if you're not going to be home.
						
					


					How Do I Return My Box?
						
							If you would like to return a box, please contact us through our Help Centre and someone from our friendly team will assist you.  All returned items in your box must be unopened and the return logged with our customer service team.  Unfortunately, we cannot offer free returns on the boxes of beer due to their heavy weight.
						
						Due to the nature of our product, all cases are non-refundable unless defective in which we will send a replacement or a refund.
					


					
					
					
					
				

				
					Manage Your Beer52 Account

					Skip, Pause or Cancel Subscription
						You can make changes to your subscription at any time by logging into your Beer52 account.
						To pause your account or update your subscription, log into your account at www.beer52.com
						
							
						

						You'll be able to manage your subscription from here. To pause your account for a month, click the “Settings” icon visible on the right hand side of your screen. This will reveal a drop-down menu from which you can select a 'Subscription' heading.
						
							
						

						Once on the subscription page, just scroll down and click on 'Pause subscription for 1 month'.
						
							
						

						To take longer holidays, simply get in touch and let us know how long you would like to pause for and we'll get this arranged for you no problem!
						To cancel your subscription, you can easily reach our team before the date of your next payment by calling 0131 285 2684. We're open Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm.
						
							
						

						Please note that we require 24 hours to process your first order before you'll be able to cancel your subscription.
					


					Update Card Details
						If you need to update your billing information, please do so by logging into your account. From there, if you click on the “Settings” icon visible on the right hand side of your screen, you'll be able to select “My Wallet” to update your card details.
						
							
						

						Remember to click 'Update' to make sure the new details are saved!
						
							
						
					


					Update Address Details
						Whether you're moving house or want your box sent to a friend's place, you can easily update your delivery details by logging into your account and clicking the “Settings” icon visible on the right hand side of your screen. From there, just select “Delivery” to update your mobile number, delivery address, as well as any delivery instructions.
						
							
						

						It's useful to think about where might be a safe place for orders to be left if you're not home when delivery is made; if you know they'll be secure with a neighbour, on the front porch or in the shed out back, be sure to let your courier know this by completing the “Delivery Instructions” fields!
						
							
						
					


					
					
					
					


					Change My Password
						To change your password, simply log into your account, and click the “Settings” icon on the right hand side of your screen - from there you'll see a “Login Details” heading which, if clicked, will take you to this page where you can update your password.
						
							
						

						Just remember to click 'Update' for changes to apply! If you run into any difficulty here just contact us through our Help Centre and we'll get you sorted.
					


					
					
					
					
					
					


					Refer A Friend
						You can find the FAQ's for our refer a friend schemes HERE - https://www.beer52.com/invite-friend
					
				
				
					Christmas & New Year period

					Will my delivery be impacted during the holiday period?
						
							There will be some disruption to our usually prompt delivery timeframes around the Christmas and New Year period. Please note that no deliveries will be made on the following dates:
							
							
							24th December
							25th December
							26th December
							1st January
							

							Thank you for your understanding and patience during this time.
						
					

					When do I need to order by if I want my delivery to arrive before Christmas?
						
                            To ensure your delivery arrives before Christmas, please place your order by 9:00 PM on Friday, 19th December 2025.
							
                            Please note that this is a busier-than-normal period, and while we will do our best to meet this timeframe, unexpected delays may occur.
						
					

					When do I need to order by if I want my delivery to arrive before New Year’s Eve?
						
							To ensure your delivery arrives before New Year’s Eve, please place your order by 9:00 PM on Monday, 22nd December 2025. This is for orders opting for Express Delivery.
							
							Please be aware that this is a busier-than-normal period, and while we will strive to meet this timeframe, unexpected delays may occur.
						
					

					Will you be open during the holiday period?
						
							Our team will be here to support you as usual until up to and including Tuesday, 23rd December 2025. However, our offices will be closed on the following days:
							
							Christmas Eve
							Christmas Day
							Boxing Day
							New Year’s Day
							We will operate as normal on all other days.
							
							Thank you for your understanding and patience during this time.

						
					

					Where can I check for updates on my delivery if you are closed?
						
							For both initial sign-up and subsequent subscription orders, your order will be assigned a courier and a tracking number which can be found in your confirmation email or within your Beer52 account’s order history.
							
							You can also download the courier app for real time tracking on your box. You can update your delivery preferences by choosing a safe place, leaving your box with a neighbour or diverting your box to a new nearby address if you're not going to be home.

Wicked follows the story of Elphaba, a young woman who would become famed as the Wicked Witch of The West in The Wizard of Oz.

Singled out from birth because of her distinctive green skin, and disowned by her family, Elphaba lands a place at Shiv University, determined to turn her life around alongside her sister, Nessarose, who is paraplegic and uses a wheelchair.

However, external factors – including love interest Fiyero, discrimination in the school and ultimately a run-in with the all-powerful Wizard of Oz sends the duo on different paths in life, turning their once solid friendship into a tale of tragic rivalry.

Here’s everything you need to know about the films.

What is Wicked about?

Wicked follows the story of Elphaba, a young woman who would become famed as the Wicked Witch of The West in The Wizard of Oz.

Singled out from birth because of her distinctive green skin, and disowned by her family, Elphaba lands a place at Shiv University, determined to turn her life around alongside her sister, Nessarose, who is paraplegic and uses a wheelchair.

Once there, she is forced to become roommates with Galinda, her priveleged, popular, pink-loving classmate.

Initially starting out at odds with each other, with Galinda jealous of the attention Elphaba gets for her abilities as a sorcerer, the duo ultimately become close friends, with each learning from the other.

However, external factors – including love interest Fiyero, discrimination in the school and ultimately a run-in with the all-powerful Wizard of Oz sends the duo on different paths in life, turning their once solid friendship into a tale of tragic rivalry.

Why is Part Two called Wicked: For Good and what happens?

Part two of the Wicked films has been named Wicked: For Good, in honour of one of the most prominent songs in the musical.

For Good picks up several years after the events of what happened at Shiz University, with Galinda (now Glinda) and Elphaba on their separate journeys, as they head towards the events that occur in The Wizard Of Oz.

Now an outcast to the world, Elphaba is in hiding – but has some friends to help her when things begin to spiral out of control.

On the other side, Glinda The Good has become famed in Oz for her popularity and niceness, but is still torn about what happened to her once best friend.

Where can I watch the two Wicked movies?

The first Wicked movie is available to watch now exclusively on Sky Cinema – all you need is a subscription and you will have instant access!

Wicked: For Good will be released in cinemas on November 25, 2025, but don’t worry – even then you can still catch it for free.

Thanks to Sky’s partnership with Vue, Sky Cinema customers can get two FREE tickets to see the latest films at the cinema at no extra cost every single month.

You’re able to claim the tickets via the MySky app.

Find out more about how to get your tickets and eligible Vue cinemas here.

Who is in the cast of Wicked and where have we seen them before?

Wicked boasts an enviable, all-star cast to bring the land of Oz to life like never before.

As well as well-established on-screen stars, the films have also incorporated Broadway and West End stars, up-and-coming faces, and A-list pop acts into their casting.

Starring in Wicked is:

Cynthia Erivo (Harriet, Widows, Bad Times at the El Royale) as Elphaba Thropp

Ariana Grande (Don’t Look Up, Victorious and Thank U, Next singer) as Galinda Upland

Jonathan Bailey (Bridgerton, Fellow Travelers) as Fiyero Tigelaar

Michelle Yeoh (Everything, Everywhere All At Once, Crazy Rich Asians) as Madame Morrible

Jeff Goldblum (KAOS, Jurassic Park, The Fly) as The Wizard

Ethan Slater (Spongebob The Musical on Broadway, Fosse/Verdon) as Boq

Bowen Yang (Fire Island, Saturday Night Live) as Pfannee

Bronwyn James (Lockwood and Co, Renegade Nell, Harlots) as ShenShen

Keala Settle (The Greatest Showman, Les Miserables on Broadway) as Miss Coddle

Peter Dinklage (Game of Thrones, The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes) as the voice of Doctor Dillamond

Adam James (Doctor Foster, I May Destroy You) as Galinda's father

Colin Michael Carmichael (Black Mirror: 15 Million Merits, Hot Fuzz) as Professor Nikidik

Newcomer Aaron Teoh Guan Ti as Averic

Newcomer Marissa Bode as Nessarose Thropp

Newcomer Grecia de la Paz as Gilligan

Most of the above cast appear in Wicked: For Good, but with ties to The Wizard of Oz, new cast members are due to be announced.

Colman Domingo (Rustin, Euphoria) as The Cowardly Lion

Others – including Wizard of Oz leading lady Dorothy – will be announced ahead of the film’s release.

What is the age rating of Wicked?

Wicked: Part One has been given a PG rating by the British Board of Film Classification (BBFC).

This means the film has been deemed suitable for children with some parental guidance.

Reasons for this rating is due to the film containing:

Scenes of peril and threat

Fantasy violence

Themes of cruelty to animals some may find upsetting

Scenes of cruelty to children by adults

Themes of bullying including parables of racism and prejudice

No violence or profanity

One implication of sex occurring off-camera, but nothing explicitly shown

Wicked: For Good is not yet rated.

Here is your complete guide for planning a monthly subscription night in the UK, with all evidence pages left open in their respective browser tabs.

---

### 1. Beer52: Genuine Monthly UK Subscription Plans

Beer52 operates as an ongoing discovery club billed every 28 days (monthly cadence) delivering across the UK (mainland via Evri/InPost, plus Northern Ireland, Scottish Highlands, and Isle of Man via Evri). Every monthly case includes a curated craft beer selection based on a rotating monthly theme, a 100-page full-colour copy of *Ferment* magazine, and 2 artisan beer snacks.

#### Plan Tiers:
* **8-Beer Club (Baseline Plan):**
  * **Price:** £27 for the first case, then £29.95 every 28 days (£27 base plan + £2.95 delivery charge applied from the 2nd order onwards).
  * **Contents:** 8 craft beers (bottles/cans), *Ferment* magazine, and 2 artisan snacks.
* **10-Beer Club (Upgrade Plan):**
  * **Price:** £33/month (+ £2.95 delivery from 2nd box; £6 add-on to the baseline plan).
  * **Contents:** 10 craft beers, *Ferment* magazine, and 2 artisan snacks.
* **12-Beer Club:**
  * **Price:** £39/month (+ £2.95 delivery from 2nd box).
  * **Contents:** 12 craft beers, *Ferment* magazine, and 2 artisan snacks.
* **16-Beer Club:**

### 4. PrintPigeon: How It Works & UK Letter Pricing

#### How it turns an online message into a physical posted letter (in plain English):
1. **Compose or Upload:** You visit PrintPigeon online and either paste/type your message into their web editor (or pick an invite template) or upload a pre-made PDF or Word document containing your letter.
2. **Addressing & Proofing:** You enter the recipient’s UK postal address and your return details. PrintPigeon displays an instant digital PDF proof on screen so you can verify layout and margins.
3. **Printing & Packaging:** Once submitted, PrintPigeon prints the document on 100gsm paper using high-grade laser printing (in black & white or full colour). Automated machinery folds the letter, places it into an envelope, and seals it.
4. **Franking & Posting:** PrintPigeon franks the envelope and hands it over directly to **Royal Mail** for physical delivery. Orders submitted before 2:30 PM (Monday–Friday) are dispatched the same day.

#### Current Price for Sending One Standard UK Letter (1 Page):
* **Base Printing & Envelope Fee:** **£2.99** (includes first page printing, premium envelope, and secure handling).
* **Total Cost by Delivery Speed:**
  * **Free Standard Shipping (5–7 working days):** **£2.99 total**
  * **Royal Mail 2nd Class (2–5 working days, +£0.99):** **£3.98 total**
  * **Royal Mail 1st Class Express (1–2 working days, +£2.99):** **£5.98 total**
  * **Royal Mail 2nd Class Tracked (+£3.99):** **£6.98 total**
  * **Royal Mail 1st Class Tracked (+£4.99):** **£7.98 total**
  * *(Extra pages, if your letter exceeds one page, cost £0.30/page for B&W or £0.40/page for colour).*
